segments.JUD.1.3-4: Jude urges believers to defend the faith from ungodly men
segments.JUD.1.5-6: God punished unbelieving Israelites and rebel angels
segments.JUD.1.9-11: Michael did not slander the devil; ungodly men do
segments.JUD.1.12-13: Jude compares the ungodly men to reefs, clouds and waves
segments.JUD.1.14-16: Enoch said the Lord will judge the ungodly
segments.JUD.1.17-19: The apostles warned believers about scoffers
segments.JUD.1.20-21: Jude urges believers to stay in God’s love
segments.JUD.1.22-23: Believers should show mercy to doubters and save others
